feature_dispositions.rationale: Scored: drowsiness → song arousal/valence traits (+0.80·A_s + 0.20·V_s).
Scored via directional hypothesis (−0.50·A_s + 0.50·V_s); §5.6 ⚠.
Scored categorical; per-enum responses recorded; congested is a ⚠ hypothesis.
Scored categorical; §9 marks the enum normalized (feature_origin=normalized).
Scored categorical; night is a ⚠ directional hypothesis.
Scored: monotony → +0.90·A_s + 0.10·V_s.
Genre-gated: scored via genre_affinity_v1 route→genre map when the extension is on (mask 1); context-only when off.
Genre-gated: scored via destination→genre map when the extension is on.
Genre-gated: scored via child-friendly genre map when extension is on; also drives explicit eligibility (§7).
Context-only: no group-appeal song field exists in V1.
Scored categorical; driving is a ⚠ hypothesis; stopped also gates full-karaoke eligibility.
Context-only gate: enables the Oshi ID score; not a standalone score.
Context-only gate: `off` forces the oshi gate to 0; enables Oshi ID, not standalone.

Scored: gate-enabled match of spotify_track.artists[*].id against the driver's registered oshi artists, using the MAX 熱狂度 (enthusiasm) among matched artists as the affinity (feature 025 slice S2 — replaces the single oshi_id exact match with a list so a driver can register several oshi, each at a different intensity); §9 marks the identity normalized (feature_origin=normalized).
Context-only: no song semantic tags in V1.
